certs.title: Platform exams
certs.source: Freelancer.com / vWorker hire-platform record, as shown on 19 September 2026 screenshots.
certs.rule: The hire-platform UI labels these Certifications. On this domain they stay marketplace exams. Not a ministry diploma. Not a doctorate. School record stays on Method.

item.label: Unix
item.what: The tile text Unix is a hire-platform exam on Unix-family command line and process basics.
item.note: A marketplace pass is not the same object as years on a box. Operator record of systems administration starts 2002 and lives on Method.

item.label: Nginx
item.what: The tile text Nginx is a hire-platform exam on the Nginx HTTP server and reverse proxy.
item.note: It tests vocabulary for static files, proxy_pass, and virtual hosts. It is not a vendor certificate from F5/Nginx Inc.

item.label: SQL
item.what: The tile text SQL is a hire-platform exam on generic Structured Query Language: select, join, filter, aggregate.
item.note: Kept separate from the MySQL product exam on the same record.

item.label: MySQL
item.what: The tile text MySQL is a hire-platform exam on the MySQL database product, not on SQL as a language in the abstract.
item.note: Product exam. Distinct from the SQL tile.

item.label: HTML
item.what: The tile text HTML is a hire-platform exam on markup structure, elements, and document outline.
item.note: Not a W3C membership and not a living-standard editorship.

item.label: PHP
item.what: The tile text PHP is a hire-platform exam on PHP language basics used in older web stacks.
item.note: One exam. The record shows the same PHP tile twice across screens; it is not two credentials.

item.label: JavaScript
item.what: The tile text JavaScript is a hire-platform exam on JS language basics in the browser era of the test.
item.note: Not TC39 membership. Not a Node.js foundation credential.

item.label: C# Programming
item.what: The tile text C# Programming is a hire-platform exam on C# syntax and object basics.
item.note: Not a Microsoft Certified credential. No exam ID from Microsoft is claimed here.

item.label: WordPress
item.what: The tile text WordPress is a hire-platform exam on WordPress as a CMS: themes, posts, plugins at the level the test used.
item.note: Not a WordPress.org or Automattic staff credential. The live domain currently still has a default WordPress Hello world until the static spine replaces the document root.

item.label: Adobe Photoshop CS5
item.what: The tile text Adobe Photoshop CS5 is a hire-platform exam on Photoshop as it existed in the CS5 product line.
item.note: Dated tool. CS5 is a 2010-era release. Not a current Adobe Certified Professional ID.

item.label: SEO
item.what: The tile text SEO is a hire-platform exam on search-engine optimisation vocabulary: titles, crawlers, links, on-page basics.
item.note: A marketplace quiz is not a ranking. This domain does not sell a miracle listing.

item.label: US English
item.what: The tile text US English is a hire-platform language exam. Two stars are what the record shows.
item.note: A language exam on a hire site is not a university degree in English. School English sits on the Vukova diploma line on Method.

item.label: UK English
item.what: The tile text UK English is a hire-platform language exam. Two stars are what the record shows.
item.note: Kept beside US English because the platform issued two tiles. Spelling variants are not two diplomas.

item.label: Basic Numeracy
item.what: The tile text Basic Numeracy is a hire-platform arithmetic exam: the four operations as the test framed them.
item.note: Not a mathematics degree. School mathematics sits on the Vukova diploma line on Method.

item.label: AdWords
item.what: The tile text AdWords is a hire-platform exam on Google’s paid-search product under the name it used before Google Ads.
item.note: Not a current Google Skillshop certificate unless a Skillshop ID is produced. None is on this record.

item.label: Google AdSense
item.what: The tile text Google AdSense is a hire-platform exam on the AdSense publisher product: placements, policies, basic reporting.
item.note: Not proof of an active AdSense account on this domain. This site ships with no ads and no tracker.

item.label: Freelancer Orientation
item.what: The tile text Freelancer Orientation is a platform onboarding exam: how that marketplace expected sellers to behave.
item.note: Orientation, not a skill. freelancer.com/u/kerberus remains a hire record from 2006, not a current bid profile on this domain.

item.label: Employer Orientation Exam
item.what: The tile text Employer Orientation Exam is a platform onboarding exam for the hiring side of the same marketplace.
item.note: Orientation, not a skill. It does not make this domain a staffing agency.

item.label: General Orientation Exam
item.what: The tile text General Orientation Exam is a catch-all platform onboarding test.
item.note: Orientation, not a skill.

item.label: Foundation vWorker Member
item.what: The tile text Foundation vWorker Member is a legacy membership badge from vWorker, a hire marketplace later absorbed by Freelancer.
item.note: No star on the tile. Membership, not an exam score. Do not restyle it as a university foundation year.
